name: Hugo Boss
note: Men-focused: Boss is mainly a men's house, led by the Bottled line. Bottled Absolu (8.4 from 2,035) and Bottled Intense EDP are the standouts; the famous original Boss Bottled EDT has the most ratings but scores 7.4. The women's tab is The Scent for Her, Alive, Deep Red and older lines. Only Boss's 40 most popular scents could be read from Parfumo.
